 Reviewed: Jan 2011
مقدمة

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I3, which must be performed every 
five 
years كما هو موضح بواسطة Y5 في مقطع العنوان.

This document used 
for المحركات التالية للوحدة 1،2:

Gas Recirculation fan motor, forced 
draft fan motor, main cooling water pump motor, and main condensate pump motor 
6kv.

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. 
Ibrahem Youssef Abdel Latif, 
tested by eng. 
عيد لطفي طلبة,
مقبولة من قبل المهندس. 
Sayed Mahmoud Hussein Farag: 
general director, 
تم تنقيحه بواسطة EDEPC لمراقبة الجودة المهندس. عادل عبد القادر 
النجار وسعد محمود بسوني و 
approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abd El-Latif Mady: head 
sector of Ataka PS.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
مطلوب العزلة والتأريض السليم

Before starting any work on the motor, check that it is switched off and 
 blocked up for switching on again.
The unit should be out of service.

Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth.... etc.
Lifting device, press on and detaching device.

AVO 
 meter & insulation testing device.
Vibration and noise level measuring device.
Greasing device.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Check the vibration and noise level.
Clean the heat exchanger.
Remove rotor and fit a new bearing.
Grease the bearing.
Check tightness of stator core and rotor bars for breaks & clean.
Clean and check tightness of bracing and slots wedges, measure insulation resistance for stator winding.
Cleaning inside terminal box and tighten bolts & earthing bolts.

General cleaning 
 for the motor.
Measure the insulation resistance for stator winding.
